articles.title: Bitcoin gets a green light from a reliable momentum gauge. Here are key levels to watch
articles.snippet: A smoother long-term MACD just flipped bullish, pointing to more upside. Here are key levels that will decide if the ongoing bounce turns into a full blown uptrend.

articles.title: Bitcoin Stalls as Ethereum Flashes Worst Weekly Signal in Years: Analysis
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is looking slightly more optimistic but failed the breakout everyone was watching. Meanwhile, ETH just printed a weekly death cross for the first time in years.
